title: The ten best time travel movies to buy and own on Blu-ray and 4K UHD Blu-ray this Black Friday
summary: From timey-wimey action movies to thought-provoking temporal thrillers, get physical with the best time travel movies to own on Blu-ray — now cheaper for Black Friday
contentText:
Love time travel movies? You're not alone and, as a sci-fi staple, cinema has no shortage of timey-wimey greats. It's Black Friday week and many of these titles are now deeply discounted. So, I picked out the ten time travel movies you need to own, from classic blockbusters like Back to the Future, through to modern gems such as Needle in a Timestack, where the only obstacle to time travel is your bank balance.

We do mean own, too. All too often, we've sat down to rewatch a film to find it's vanished from our streaming service. At best, it's rematerialized on a different streaming service; at worst, it's been exterminated as some media conglomerate's tax write-off. Even 'buying' a movie, you're just getting a license that can be revoked at any time.

The solution? By buying these time travel movies on Blu-ray or 4K UHD Blu-ray, they'll still be sitting on your shelf ready to watch and rewatch for years, even decades, from now.
